info.title: Booking Engine API
info.description: Property setup, pricing and availability for hotel distribution.

put.description: Currency is immutable because stored rates are denominated in it.

delete.description: Cascades to room types, rate plans and all ARI data of the property.

get.summary: List room types of a property

put.description: The code is immutable because channels map inventory by it.

delete.description: Cascades to its rate plans and ARI data.

post.description: Per-person plans price each adult count relative to the daily base rate. Derived plans take their rate from a parent plan with a percent or fixed adjustment.

get.summary: List rate plans of a property

put.description: Code and sell mode are immutable; omitting `derived` detaches the plan from its parent.

post.summary: Set room type availability for date ranges
post.description: Each value sets the sellable room count of a room type for every date in [date_from, date_to], optionally limited to weekdays. Later values win when ranges overlap.

post.summary: Patch rates and restrictions for date ranges
post.description: Only the fields present in a value are changed; omitted fields keep their stored value. New dates default to open with a minimum stay of one night. Send max_stay 0 to remove a maximum stay.
